Esri World Imagery 2026-11-20 (350, 200, 120 and 110 m half-widths): the FS/Google point lies on a track running SW into continuous conifer forest from a spur off the west side of FSR 27 at its junction by West Tensleep Creek; the campground is under canopy. The creek and a pond lie in the open meadow N and E of the junction, ~45 m from the head of the spur through trees and ~130 m from the FS point, with FSR 27 between on the east. The stored pin (44.24620,-107.22300) is in that meadow by the creek, ~240 m N of the campground; a cluster of trailers parked in the meadow NE of the junction (~44.2453,-107.2217) has no pads, tables or loop and looks like dispersed camping.

note: Small Bighorn NF campground in the trees beside West Tensleep Creek, about 20 miles east of Ten Sleep on US-16 and then 6 miles north on gravel FSR 27, near trails into the Cloud Peak Wilderness. Up to 8 people per site. The FS publishes no site lengths. No horses. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated 2026-09-08) read: FCFS only (no rec.gov), 14-day limit, $20 (8 people max), vault toilets + water, Memorial Day-Labor Day, gated off-season. Facilities, booking, fees, season written. RECOMMEND creekside -> not waterfront (campground is under conifers; the stored evidence measured a meadow ~240 m north). RE-PIN 44.24620,-107.22300 -> 44.24401,-107.22340 (~240 m). Phone empty -> 307-696-1403.
flags: WATERFRONT stored 'creekside': RECOMMEND DOWNGRADE to 'not waterfront'. The stored evidence ('satellite at 44.2457,-107.2222: RV sites in open meadow edge ~30m from West Tensleep Creek') measured the open meadow by the creek, ~240 m north of the campground. The FS point and Google both put the campground at ~44.2440,-107.2234, on a track under continuous conifer canopy west of FSR 27. The creek and pond are ~45 m from the head of the spur through trees and ~130 m from the campground point, with trees and the road between. No site can be seen at the water, and a creek this size gives no view value. The trailers parked in the meadow NE of the junction (~44.2453,-107.2217, ~40-45 m from the creek) have no pads or tables and look like dispersed camping, not campground sites.

PIN: 44.24620,-107.22300 -> 44.24401,-107.22340 (FS point; Google 44.2440347,-107.2233733). The stored pin is ~240 m north in the creek meadow; just under the 250 m line, but it sits on the wrong feature.

SITES: the current FS page gives no site count or length; stored count 7 left as is. The inclusion evidence ('open meadow loop, big rigs observed') appears to describe the meadow, not the campground in the trees; site lengths are unknown, so the note carries a caveat.
SEASON: Memorial Day to Labor Day written as 2027 dates (05-31 to 09-06); gated after the season.
PHONE: empty -> 307-696-1403 (Powder River Ranger District, FS page). Google lists 307-684-7806 (an older district number).
